name: io.github.TurtleTech-ehf/ookcite-mcp
title: OokCite
description: Validate DOIs and ISBNs against the real record, format citations in 2900+ CSL styles, and catch fabricated references before they ship. Returns citation metadata, not paper content.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Raises the anonymous rate limit and enables the collection tools. Sign up at https://my.turtletech.us/signup
